question.prompt: In \(\triangle ABC\) and \(\triangle DEF\), \(\angle A=\angle D\), \(\angle B=\angle E\), \(AC=DF=5\), and \(BC=4\). Find the length of \(EF\).

solutions.explanation: \(AC\) is opposite \(\angle B\), and \(DF\) is opposite \(\angle E\). By AAS, \(\triangle ABC\cong\triangle DEF\), so \(EF=BC=4\).
solutions.title: AAS and corresponding sides
